title: Benchmarking Python Web Frameworks under Generative AI Workloads: benchmark code and data
description: Benchmark harness and data for the paper "Benchmarking Python Web Frameworks under Generative AI Workloads: A Comparison of Synchronous and Asynchronous Architectures". Flask and Django (Gunicorn sync, 1 and 17 workers), FastAPI (Uvicorn) and Tornado serve blocking, SSE streaming and RAG-style pipeline endpoints in front of a calibrated simulator of the Anthropic Messages API, at 1 to 100 concurrent users with 5 runs per configuration, plus a validation against the live API. Code is MIT licensed; the data in data_v2/, data_v2_real/, results_v2/, analysis/out/, data/ and results/ are licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
